input_policy: observable-only inputs; loss-only assessment; balanced crash-centred; axis-selected single-channel timing with complete filter support; geometry outer rho .4-.65
diagnosis_scope: fitting and inner-selection fixed-train shots only
hyperparameter_selection: fixed optimizer; inner selection masked loss stopping

derivative_baseline.selection: independent inner selection crash F1 at +/-2 ms and presence F1; largest z breaks ties within each task
derivative_baseline.presence_rule: any >=inner-selected presence_z sigma edge within +/-125 ms
derivative_baseline.input: one raw ECE channel nearest the nominal EFIT magnetic axis

window_sampling: half natural random, half crash-centred; crash-centred samples balance the available small/large period classes per shot; identical policy for both models
unknown_truth: observability alone masks inputs; assessed supervision/scoring excludes uncertain bins while keeping observable measurements
